Using 'firstString' with an empty string fallback '' will always return null if both 'params.query' and 'params.q' are empty or undefined, because 'firstString' skips empty strings. This can cause the 'query' field to be null instead of '', which might lead to unexpected behavior or runtime errors in the frontend. Consider using the nullish coalescing operator to provide the empty string fallback.

```suggestion
    query: firstString(params.query, params.q) ?? '',
```

Checking '!res.writableEnded' is not sufficient to guarantee that headers haven't been sent yet. If some chunked data has already been written to the response but 'res.end()' hasn't been called, trying to set headers or status in 'errorResponse' will throw a 'Cannot set headers after they are sent to the client' error. Using '!res.headersSent' is more robust and standard.

```suggestion
      if (!res.headersSent) {
```

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prefer canonical topic ids over stale PR4 slugs**

When Paper Workspace starts from `DEFAULT_PR4_SELECTION_STATE`, `params.topicId` is still the old PR4 slug (`integration-techniques`) before the `/api/learning/workspaces/papers/...` envelope has loaded. This line prefers that stale value over the canonical `firstSection.topicId` from the learning envelope (the contract fixtures use `topic_id: "topic-1"`), so the adapter reports the old topic as current and the subsequent `useTopic`/`useReviewTasks`/`useArtifacts` calls filter by a topic id the learning backend does not have, leaving the runtime empty/null instead of repairing to the canonical topic.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid fetching placeholder session ids from learning sessions**

On initial Paper Workspace renders, `sessionId` defaults to `session-integration-001`, but the real `/api/learning/sessions/:id` path rejects non-UUID ids in `readLearningSession` before lookup. This direct delegation makes the default study-session query fail every time after the namespace switch; gate fixture placeholder ids or resolve/create a real learning session UUID before calling the canonical session endpoint.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Translate PR4 status labels before querying review tasks**

When existing PR4 callers pass display statuses, such as `useReviewTasks({ status: 'Open' })` in `CieObjectGalleryPage`, this forwards the capitalized value through to `/api/learning/review-tasks?status=Open`. The learning review queue stores and filters canonical lowercase statuses like `open`, so those queries now return an empty queue even though tasks exist; the compatibility layer should normalize PR4 display labels before delegating.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve real workspace posture in PR4 records**

For real `/api/learning/workspaces/papers/:paperScope` responses, `buildPaperWorkspaceCompatibilityEnvelope` returns paper scope, topic sections, and review queue data but no `runtime_posture`; only the new test double adds one. Because the adapter reads posture exclusively from `envelope.runtimePosture`, every workspace-derived PR4 record drops blocked/provisional runtime posture in production, despite this being the path that now backs paper/topic/artifact reads.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include non-pinned artifacts in compatibility lists**

When the Artifact Library calls `useArtifacts()` without a placement filter, this adapter now returns only `section.pinnedArtifacts` and slot summaries. The canonical paper workspace projection builds those summaries from pinned artifact candidates, while inbox/archived artifacts are not included there, so once any pinned artifact exists the V1 artifact library stops falling back to fixtures and its Inbox/Archived sections become empty for users with saved non-pinned artifacts.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep artifact detail routes resolvable after exposing runtime ids**

When the runtime workspace returns artifacts such as `artifact-primary`, this line exposes that raw backend id to `ArtifactCard`, which links to `/artifacts/:artifactId`. The detail route still resolves details with the fixture-only `getArtifactById`, so clicking a runtime artifact id that is not in `paperWorkspaceMockData.artifacts` renders the fallback fixture artifact instead of the selected runtime artifact.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accumulate all review tasks linked to an attempt**

When the learning review queue contains multiple review tasks with the same `sourceAttemptId`, this early `continue` keeps only the first one and drops the rest from `linkedReviewTaskIds`. The PR4 attempt contract exposes those linked review task ids, so source-attempt views lose valid repair links whenever one attempt produces more than one review task.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
